en.topic_title: Hong Kong court orders activist Eddie Tse to pay gov’t legal fees over dropped San Tin Technopole challenge
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has ordered environmental activist Eddie Tse to pay legal fees after he dropped a challenge against the government’s decision to build a huge technology hub near the city’s border with mainland China.



Eddie Tse in front of Hong Kong’s High Court on November 11, 2024. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



The High Court handed down judgment on Tuesday ordering Tse to pay the legal costs of the Environmental Protection Department and the Civil Engineering and Develo
